spec.title: Lithrim — talk to the case you're evaluating

card.heading: Lithrim
bullets: Labels true by construction · a grounding floor that can overrule the judges
card.narration: Lithrim is an evaluation workspace for clinical AI. Every label is true by construction, and a tool-grounded floor can overrule a confident-but-wrong judge.

steps.say: Here is a real imported case: a diabetes SOAP note flagged as a clean violation.
I select it in the rail — this is now the active case.

steps.value: Which case am I evaluating right now? Show its config and review its runs.
steps.say: And I just ask, in plain language, what I am evaluating.
The assistant loads its Lithrim tools and reads the agent I selected.

It names the exact case I picked — not a default — reports its three-judge council and clinical ontology, and pulls its run history: a blocked verdict. It cannot fire a paid run; that stays my decision.

card.heading: Verifiable truth, not a promised win
card.narration: The labels are true by construction, and a verification floor can flip a verdict the judges got wrong. That is the moat: we sell verifiable truth, never a manufactured win.

card.heading: How it is built
bullets: An audited config plane — judges, flags, ontology, every change logged
A live judge council plus a grounding floor that can overrule it
Mongo-free — runs in your own environment
card.narration: Underneath: an auditable config plane, a live judge council, and a grounding floor — all running in your own environment.

card.heading: Open core. Premium vertical packs. Healthcare first.
card.narration: Open core for the platform, premium packs for regulated verticals — healthcare first.
